color.note: One light theme (the field theme). The scoreboard tokens colour one dark surface inside it; they are not a dark mode. Contrast ratios in each note are WCAG 2 against the grounds named.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background of every light screen; the rulebook's cream. Also the text colour on navy (see on-navy).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on paper: job cards, list rows, runner tiles, inputs, place-time slots, small buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline round cards and the border of small buttons and chips on paper. Decorative only (1.2:1 on paper): never the only cue that something is a control; pair it with a label, chevron or the tile's navy base.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of empty or not-placed rows, the sheet grip. Decorative (1.8:1 on paper); the row always carries a word saying its state.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The ink. All text on paper (11.2:1) and card (12.9:1); primary button fill; app bar; text on every bright fill: gold 8.0:1, running 4.8:1, jumping 5.1:1, throwing 6.2:1, challenge 5.2:1, warn-soft 12.3:1. Focus ring on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper (7.7:1), card (8.8:1), warn-soft (8.4:1) and line (6.2:1): descriptions, race context lines, hints, the Updated-at line.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy (11.2:1), scoreboard (12.8:1) and scoreboard-row (10.3:1); also on red-ink fills (4.75:1).

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on card (5.3:1), always written as an example (e.g. 205), never as the label.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Attention and 'now': the current place in the trail, the current time slot, place ordinals (1ST) on navy, times of qualifiers on the scoreboard, the TIE tag, the gold speed stripe, the Saved star, focus ring on dark grounds. As text only on navy (8.0:1) or scoreboard (9.0:1); on paper it is a fill with navy text (1.4:1 as text: never).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The red speed stripe and the qualifying line only. Never text, never a fill under text (3.4:1).

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: The one emphasised word in a prompt (Who came 3RD?), the to-check dot, the alert badge fill and the danger button fill. As text on paper 4.75:1; as a fill it carries on-navy text (4.75:1).

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Running Zone colour, from the rulebook. Fills with navy on top (4.8:1): rank stars, runner-tile star, active zone tab, R4 tag, the zone word in the hero. As text only on navy (4.8:1) or scoreboard (5.5:1). Never text on paper (2.3:1): use running-ink.

tokens.name: running-ink
tokens.usage: Running colour as text on paper (5.0:1) or card.

tokens.name: jumping
tokens.usage: Jumping Zone colour (rulebook prints #be53ff; lightened so navy text reads on it at 5.1:1). Fills with navy text; as text on navy (5.1:1) or scoreboard (5.8:1).

tokens.name: jumping-ink
tokens.usage: Jumping colour as text on paper (6.3:1).

tokens.name: throwing
tokens.usage: Throwing Zone colour (rulebook prints #418701; lightened so navy text reads on it at 6.2:1). Fills with navy text; as text on navy (6.2:1) or scoreboard (7.1:1).

tokens.name: throwing-ink
tokens.usage: Throwing colour as text on paper (5.3:1) or card (6.1:1). Also the ok tick text.

tokens.name: challenge
tokens.usage: Challenge Zone colour, from the rulebook; also the Finishing-order job star. Fills with navy text (5.2:1); as text on navy (5.2:1) or scoreboard (5.9:1).

tokens.name: challenge-ink
tokens.usage: Challenge colour as text on paper (4.9:1).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The live dot beside 'Heats running' on the scoreboard. Always next to the words.

tokens.name: scoreboard
tokens.usage: Background of the scoreboard surface (results leaderboard) only.

tokens.name: scoreboard-row
tokens.usage: Leaderboard rows on scoreboard.

tokens.name: scoreboard-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of leaderboard rows. Decorative.

tokens.name: scoreboard-line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline rank squares, the live chip outline and dashed rows outside the highlighted top places, on scoreboard (3.4:1) and scoreboard-row (2.7:1, decorative there: the row says its state in words).

tokens.name: scoreboard-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on scoreboard (8.6:1), scoreboard-row (6.9:1) and navy (7.5:1): row details, inactive zone labels.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warnings: the warning callout, an input or slot holding a value that needs a look, the Kept tag.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: 2px border of warning surfaces: 3.8:1 on paper, 4.4:1 on card, 4.2:1 on warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Warning icon and Kept tag text on warn-soft (7.2:1).

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Label of a disabled button on disabled-fill (4.9:1).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a bottom sheet.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Saira from Google Fonts, always italic, always font-stretch 75%, always uppercase via CSS (write the copy in sentence case). bundle.css adds the stretch and the uppercase to every display-* class.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The zone name in the hero app bar on Home only; second word in the zone colour.

styles.name: display-prompt
styles.usage: The one question a task screen asks. One per screen.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Event title on the scoreboard; may break onto two lines, second line in the zone colour.

styles.name: display-code
styles.usage: Day code and lead code on Day setup.

styles.name: display-numeral
styles.usage: Wristband numbers on runner tiles.

styles.name: display-screen
styles.usage: Screen heading when the screen is a menu or list, not a single question; sheet titles.

styles.name: display-card
styles.usage: Job card titles.

styles.name: display-time
styles.usage: Times on the scoreboard.

styles.name: display-action
styles.usage: Label of the one display-primary button at the foot of a task screen.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Headings that split a list (event names on Results, list groups on pickers).

styles.name: display-appbar
styles.usage: Back link in the compact app bar.

styles.name: display-tag
styles.usage: Badges, place ordinals, place-time labels.

styles.name: display-eyebrow
styles.usage: Event eyebrow in the hero app bar; card labels such as DAY CODE.

styles.name: display-rule
styles.usage: The label set into the qualifying line.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Nunito from Google Fonts, the rulebook's rounded body face. Default weight is 600; nothing lighter than 600 on a phone in sunlight.

styles.name: input-digits
styles.usage: Digits typed into a numeric field (wristband, place time). Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Wristband numbers in chips, trails, lists and leaderboard rows; times in slots.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Issue card titles; the Saved message.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Standard and secondary button labels; list row labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap runners in the order they crossed the line.
styles.usage: Instructions and sheet text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Type each runner's wristband number before the race starts
styles.usage: Card descriptions, field hints, the Updated-at line.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The race-context line above a prompt; field labels.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Small pill buttons.

styles.name: crumb
styles.usage: Breadcrumbs; legend and live-chip text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row details, status tags, slot notes.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Zone switcher labels, the Q pill. Nothing longer than one word.

spacing.note: Px steps taken from the mockups. Screens are 390px wide with space-20 side gutters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its description inside a card; prompt line gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between leaderboard rows (5–6px); label to input.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chip and list gaps; compact app bar vertical padding; gap in rows of small buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked footer buttons and between place-trail tags.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between job cards; issue cards; icon-to-text in rows.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Job card internal gap; gap between runner tiles; zone tab gap; hero app bar gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between screen blocks on task screens.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Footer bottom padding (above the home indicator); sheet bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Space above the Saved star; between unrelated groups on long screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Slanted tags: place trail, badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Outline rank square on the scoreboard.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, leaderboard rows, place-time slots, the avatar.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Zone switcher icon tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, warning callouts; the bottom corners of runner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Job cards, issue cards, code cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of the hero app bar; top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top corners of runner tiles: the arch.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips, status tags, the live chip.

shadow.note: Flat by default: cards are set apart by a 1.5px inset hairline, not a blur. Only runner tiles have a lift, and only sheets and a dragged row float.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Job cards, list rows, slots, issue cards, code cards on paper.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Runner tiles at rest: the hard navy base says 'press me'. On press drop to shadow-card and move down 4px.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A bottom sheet; a row while it is being dragged.

size.note: Fixed component sizes. Every tap target is at least size-touch.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials square in the hero app bar (36px in the compact bar).

tokens.name: size-rank
tokens.usage: Star rank badge on the scoreboard.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Standard and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-action
tokens.usage: The display-primary button at the foot of a task screen; list rows.

tokens.name: size-job-icon
tokens.usage: Star behind a job card icon.

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: Numeric input height; place-time slots.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Runner tile height.

skew.note: The two slants of the system, used with transform: skewX().

tokens.name: skew-tag
tokens.usage: Badges, place-trail tags, the TIE tag, the R4 tag.

tokens.name: skew-stripe
tokens.usage: The red-gold-blue speed stripes in app bars.

tokens.name: opacity-pattern
tokens.usage: Stroke opacity of the 8-point star pattern on navy (0.08 on scoreboard).
